concerns.text: T013 (Classifier integration) is listed before T012 (Code block extraction). T013 consumes the output of T012 (code blocks to tag). The order must be T012 -> T013 to respect the producer-consumer dependency.

T015 (Propensity score matching) depends on T014 (static complexity metrics) and T011a (repo metadata). While T014 is listed before T015, T011a is listed before T012. The dependency chain is valid, but T015 explicitly depends on T011a and T014. Ensure T011a and T014 are completed before T015. The current order is T011a -> T012 -> T012b -> T013 -> T014 -> T015. This is valid, but T013 depends on T012, which is correct. However, T013 is marked [P] in the list but depends on T012. The [P] tag on T013 is misleading if it implies independence from T012. The text says '[P] applies only to T005 vs T006', but T013 is not in that group. T013 should not be marked [P] if it depends on T012.

T017b (Calculate classifier precision/recall) depends on T017a (Ground truth selection) and T013 (Classifier tagging). T017a is listed before T017b, and T013 is listed before T017a. The order is T013 -> T017a -> T017b. This is correct. However, T017b is marked as [ ] (incomplete) and depends on T013 which is [X] (complete). The dependency is valid, but the task status is inconsistent with the dependency chain if T013 is complete and T017b is not.
